chunks: So, when they took him out they planned to throw him into an unused well. We revealed to Joseph: "You will tell them (one day) of this deed when they will not apprehend it."
ai.seo_question: What did God reveal to Joseph regarding his brothers' plot to throw him in the well?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the transition from divine revelation to prophetic agency, where God's command to 'inform them' is often interpreted as Joseph retaining the memory of their plot to use it as a strategic test of their repentance later. The phrase 'wa hum la yash'uroon' (and they do not perceive) underscores the irony of their ignorance regarding the divine orchestration behind their seemingly random act of casting him into the well. This moment serves as a pivotal theological point illustrating how human malice is subsumed within God's greater plan for guidance and reconciliation.
